mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with triamcinolone (corticosteroid) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, hyperglycemia, and immunosuppression; corticosteroids can potentiate sympathomimetic effects and reduce antidepressant efficacy.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; assess need for alternative corticosteroid or antidepressant; monitor blood glucose; use lowest effective corticosteroid dose and shortest duration.
